resend_key_note: the key supplied as 'Full access' is restricted (API 401 restricted_api_key on /api-keys and /domains): it is already sending-only, so it is used directly as SMTP password; no extra key created; Resend API /emails listing not available with it -> delivery verified in the recipient mailbox (Gmail) instead

flows_owner_address.recipient: owner address (the only one Resend test mode delivers to)

non_owner_recipient.example.invalid: GoTrue /signup 500 unexpected_failure: Resend 550 'You can only send testing emails to your own email address' (user not created)
non_owner_recipient.delivered+tag@resend.dev: GoTrue /signup 200 (Resend test address accepted); user deleted

smoke_tooling: synthetic users no longer depend on mail: s192.Admin.create_user uses admin generate_link(signup) (no mail sent) and app_login() posts the token hash to /auth/verify
limit: Resend test mode: only the account owner's address receives mail until a domain is verified and RPG_STAGING_SMTP_ADMIN_EMAIL moves to it
